title: A failed or expired prompt-delivery write-ahead returns the head to Pending with no retry or wake, so an unpaused queue idles
outcome: A failed or expired prompt-delivery write-ahead returns the head to Pending with no retry or wake, so an unpaused queue idles
acceptance: After a write-ahead fence fails or expires (settle_prompt_delivery_write_ahead's Err arm, src/prompt_delivery.rs), or its settlement thread cannot be spawned, the receipted head on an unpaused queue is either retried by a bounded, existing-event-driven wake or shown as stalled in the session preview or error state; no new poller, watchdog or sleep is introduced, matching the item's no-timer rule.
A test fails a write-ahead on an unpaused queue and pins the chosen behaviour (retried once by the wake, or a visible stall).
